Audit._comment: The audit trail (who did what, when, from where) is written to its own database, nexpos-audit.db, next to nexpos.db. CaptureRequestBody stores the redacted JSON body of AJAX posts (up to MaxBodyBytes). RetentionDays removes entries older than that many days; 0 keeps everything forever (the default). 'ExcludedPaths' (a list of URL prefixes) can be added here to skip more noisy endpoints; the built-in list already skips static files, polling and search-as-you-type. Successful page views and list loads (GET) are not recorded; set LogReadRequests to true to record them too.

Jwt._comment: SecretKey intentionally omitted - it's a secret and must not be committed. Set it via 'dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SecretKey" "<value>"' in development, or the Jwt__SecretKey environment variable in production/Electron packaging. Must be at least 32 characters. The app throws at startup if it's missing.

IpRateLimiting._quotaExceededResponse: Content goes through string.Format (limit, period, retry-after), so literal braces are doubled.

QuotaExceededResponse.Content: {{"title":"Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.","status":429,"code":"rate_limited"}}

IpRateLimiting._generalRules: Only the sign-in is throttled (PIN guessing). A catch-all rule used to lock the whole till out of its own API on a busy shift.
